apps.name: WadBrowser
apps.summary: The browser in every wadspace, and every web app's window
apps.description: Tabs and an address bar, or Focus: tabs with no address bar, so pages only arrive by links. Each web app you add opens in its own WadBrowser window with its own name and icon, and web apps can share one sign-in (a cookie profile) or keep their own.

apps.name: VS Code
apps.description: Microsoft's code editor. Its Extensions pick its extensions, which are installed into the image so they're there on first start. A key keeps its settings and accounts, and AI extensions like Claude Code and Codex keep keys of their own.

apps.name: Obsidian
apps.description: A writing app for folders of Markdown files. Mount a project folder and open it as a vault. Obsidian Sync's login can be kept as a secret and shared with other writing wadspaces.

screenshots.caption: Examples of Obsidian's basic text formatting capabilities

apps.name: Tiled
apps.description: Lay out levels from tile sets: layers, objects and properties, saved in formats game engines read (Godot, Unity, LÖVE and more).

apps.name: LibreSprite
apps.description: Draw pixel art frame by frame: layers, onion skinning, palettes and sprite-sheet export. The free fork of Aseprite.

apps.name: Audacity
apps.description: Multi-track audio editor and recorder: cut, mix, clean up noise and export. Sound goes through the machine's PipeWire.

apps.name: LMMS
apps.summary: Make music: beats, synths and samples
apps.description: A digital audio workstation for making music from scratch: a piano roll, beat sequencer, built-in synths and effects, and MIDI keyboard support.

apps.name: Krita
apps.description: A painting app made by artists: brush engines, layers, animation and a canvas that keeps up with a pen tablet.

screenshots.caption: Krita is a full-featured digital painting studio
The startup window now also gives you the latest news about Krita
There are over ten immensely powerful brush engines

apps.name: OpenShot
apps.description: A video editor that's quick to learn: drag clips onto a timeline, trim, add titles, transitions and effects, and export.

apps.name: Steam
apps.description: Valve's game launcher, with Proton for Windows games. Its login can be kept as a secret so every gaming wadspace is signed in. Games need the machine's GPU.

apps.name: Dolphin
apps.description: Plays GameCube and Wii games in HD, with controller support and save states. Bring your own game files in a project folder.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.description: Capture the wadspace's screen, a camera and audio, mix scenes, and record or go live.

screenshots.caption: The OBS Studio window showing a card game, the project website, a video, and a purple rectangle

extensions.name: GitHub Copilot
extensions.description: AI pair programmer (sign in inside each wadspace)

extensions.name: C/C++
extensions.description: IntelliSense and debugging for C and C++

extensions.name: GitLens
extensions.description: Git blame and history in the editor

tools.name: Google Cloud CLI
tools.description: gcloud, gsutil and bq from Google's apt repo

tools.name: Rust
tools.description: rustup, cargo and the stable toolchain

tools.name: Android
tools.description: The newest Java and Gradle, adb and the Android SDK's command-line tools, without Android Studio

out.name: Writing
out.description: Obsidian, for notes and long-form writing.

out.name: Dev
out.description: WadBrowser and VS Code, for building things.
